obligations.ask: Attend the pet health plan appointment

results.segment: We are writing to confirm your pet health plan appointment with Denholm Veterinary Group on 5 June 2026 at 9.10am.
Please allow fifteen minutes for parking, and bring a list of anything you are currently taking.
Should you need to rearrange, our booking line is open on weekdays.
A duplicate charge of £33.00 raised on 2 May has been reversed.
